sentences.text: Barone sanitation Oy is a company registered on 2026-07-19 under the industry code 37000, sewerage.
A start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-07-20, and first sales are recorded on 2026-08-01.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the registered industry is sewerage, which is on the thesis list, but no public record yet shows technology or growth.
